You saved me. Thanks a lot!
Oh?
Hi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!

Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCent:
If POKéMON get tired, take them to a POKéMON CENTER.
There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE TOWN right close by.
Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass:
Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in tall grass.
If you want to catch POKéMON, you have to go into the tall grass and search.
